author: The Current
description:
Semisonic bass player John Munson stopped by The Current's Morning Show to talk about upcoming shows and his miraculous recovery amidst working on new music. 

Semisonic will be performing Thursday, July 15 at Varsity Theater, and Sunday, July 19 at Minnesota Yacht Club Festival. 

Find more information at thecurrent.org/giglist

title: John Munson on his recovery after stroke #Semisonic #JohnMunson

author: The Current
description:
Watch Singing Resistance perform "We Are Many"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Singing Resistance, a group who formed during the ICE occupation of the Twin Cities, brought their songs of community, solidarity and joy into The Current studio for a session hosted by Zach McCormick.

Watch a performance of "We Are Many" above.
